sources.games: 431 league games since 7.41 (data/heroes/item_stats), win 52.0%. Reproduce: python scripts/hero_item_stats.py sven.
sources.items: Valve /datafeed/itemdata, 7.41f: Monkey King Bar, Silver Edge, Mjollnir, Eye of Skadi, Aghanim's Scepter.

rules.name: Monkey King Bar

reason.en: {enemy} dodges attacks: with {item} most of your attacks go through the evasion
reason.uk: {enemy} ухиляється від атак: з {item} більшість ваших атак пробиває ухилення

rules.basis: Monkey King Bar pierces evasion on 80% of attacks, nothing to cast. High-rank Svens against Phantom Assassin or Windranger: 26% of 46 games against them (15% otherwise), won 67% against 38%.

build_basis: Assembled items bought in 25%+ of the won games, by median minute: bracer 25% (2), magic_wand 57% (4), power_treads 100% (6), mask_of_madness 100% (10), echo_sabre 98% (14), black_king_bar 75% (22), lesser_crit 89% (23), greater_crit 80% (26), harpoon 74% (26), satanic 42% (34), swift_blink 43% (35), aghanims_shard 33% (36).

tempo.basis: Gold lines where the hero wins 85.0%+: 20:00 12500 (81 games, 85.2%), 25:00 18000 (44 games, 90.9%), 30:00 21500 (79 games, 86.1%); net worth ~0.96 of that gold.

reason.en: Your net worth is {net_worth}, well ahead for this minute: {item} on the tempo build comes before the counters, then take the Aegis and push for the throne
reason.uk: Ваш нетворс — {net_worth}, набагато більше звичайного для цієї хвилини: спершу {item} з темпової збірки, потім заберіть Aegis і йдіть на трон

skills.basis: 431 games: maxed sven_great_cleave > sven_storm_bolt > sven_warcry 343 (win 52.5%), sven_great_cleave > sven_warcry > sven_storm_bolt 72 (win 52.8%), sven_great_cleave > sven_storm_bolt 9 (win 22.2%); talents 10: Warcry Duration 266/430 (56.0%), God's Strength Slow Resistance 164/430 (45.1%); 15: God's Strength Cooldown 250/417 (54.4%), Great Cleave Damage 167/417 (51.5%); 20: Warcry Armor 252/322 (60.7%), Storm Hammer Cooldown and Mana Cost 70/322 (65.7%); 25: God's Strength Damage 125/167 (65.6%), Storm Hammer Stun Duration 42/167 (66.7%).

suppress.illusions: Great Cleave (maxed first in 343 of 431 games) hits 90% of his attack damage in a 700 cone, so illusions around the target fall with it; high-rank Svens do not buy Maelstrom against illusion heroes.
